test_title: PYST 09: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Arrange the sentence parts:

(A) a scholarship (B) for higher studies (C) was awarded (D) the topper
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (1)** i.e. **DCAB**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The sentence begins with the subject "The topper," which is correctly indicated by **part (D).**
 
• Following the subject, "was awarded" **(DC)** continues the logical sequence, making it clear what happened to the topper.
 
• **The next part,** "a scholarship," completes the idea of what was awarded, indicated by (A).
 
• **Ending with **"for higher studies" (B) completes the sentence by providing the purpose of the scholarship.

Therefore, the correct answer is **DABC.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 2 (****DABC****):** This option starts with "the topper a scholarship for higher studies," which creates a grammatically incorrect sentence.
 
• **Option 3 (DACB):** This option starts with "the topper was awarded a scholarship for higher studies," but places "a scholarship" before "for higher studies" in a way that doesn't follow the logical sequence.
 
• **Option 4 (DBCA):** This option starts with "the topper a scholarship was awarded for higher studies," which creates a confusing structure.
